title: Adaptive cross-region failover coordinator with warm-standby prequalification
creator: Arianna Chen
description:
Problem: During multi-region incidents we currently flip traffic to standby regions without a consistent readiness check that validates model variant compatibility, KV cache warmness, and batch latency under expected mix. This has caused transient errors and tail-latency spikes for high-throughput customers.

Goal: Implement an adaptive failover coordinator that scores candidate standby regions and individual standby pools using a composite readiness metric. The coordinator will gate cutovers behind a pass score, perform staged traffic ramping, and automatically fall back to compatible fallback model variants if a full readiness pass cannot be reached.

Scope: orchestration logic, readiness probe definitions, warm-standby priming tasks, cutover playbook automation, telemetry events and dashboards, and a safe rollback mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: Coordinator computes a per-region readiness_score (0-100) composed of health, kv_cache_warmth, model_variant_match, capacity_headroom, recent_tail_p50_p99 latency signals.
Readiness scoring components and thresholds are configurable per-customer and per-tier via policy config.
Automatic cutover only occurs when readiness_score >= 80 (default) and capacity_headroom >= configured reserve.
When readiness < threshold, coordinator performs staged priming: sample traffic shadowing, synthetic prefix probes, and KV prefetch; readiness recomputed within configurable window.
If certain model weights are incompatible (e.g., precision/quantization mismatch), coordinator may route to a compatible fallback_variant and annotate telemetry.
All cutovers produce an immutable runbook entry with start/end timestamps, decision rationale, and linked PR/console snapshot.
End-to-end integration tests that simulate regional outage show no increase in customer 5xxs above historical baseline during cutover for test tenants.
Telemetry dashboards (region-readiness, cutover-events, fallback-variant-usage) created and instrumented with alerts for anomalous degradation.
tasks: Design readiness_score schema and weight defaults (health, cache_warmth, latency, capacity, variant_compatibility)
Implement region readiness probe engine (health checks + synthetic prefix probes + KV cache inspector)
Extend model registry API to report variant compatibility and allowed fallbacks per model family
Build failover coordinator service with policy evaluation and staged ramping logic
Wire coordinator telemetry events to Console and create dashboards/alerts
Add automated runbook creation and post-cutover diff snapshots
Create integration tests that simulate outage and verify gating/recovery behavior
Run canary with internal low-traffic tenants, iterate on thresholds
test_plan: Unit tests for readiness_score computation with synthetic component inputs
Component test: KV cache inspector verifies prefix residency and estimated warmness
Integration test: Simulate region loss and validate staged priming path and traffic ramping
Chaos test: randomly delay priming probes to validate timeout and fallback behavior
Load test: ensure cutover ramping controls prevent backend overload
rollout_plan: Stage 0: feature-flagged rollout to internal infra tenants (1 week)
Stage 1: opt-in rollout to low-traffic production tenants, supervised cutovers only (2 weeks)
Stage 2: enable auto-cutover with conservative defaults for all multi-region customers (4 weeks)
Rollback: immediate traffic revert to previous region and open incident with runbook link
